children: Sean Dollinger Steps Down as Chief Executive Officer
MIAMI BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 /
today announced that Sean Dollinger has stepped down as Chief Executive Officer, effective October 16, 2026. Leo Chen will become Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately.

This change follows LQR's strategic pivot toward its New Zealand-based acquisition, Fusion Five Continents Securities, alongside several other initiatives, including a technology agreement with ByteDance. Mr. Dollinger believes the Company will be better served by a Chief Executive Officer with the operational background for this new direction. In connection with Mr. Dollinger's departure from LQR House, the online spirits business will be transferred to a company owned by Kumar Abhishek, the outgoing CFO of LQR House.

Mr. Chen has over 10 years of executive management experience in large enterprises and diversified conglomerates. He is the former Chairman of Shenzhen Jincheng Confidentiality Technology Co., Ltd., and served as the General Manager of the Finance Department of Beijing Energy International Holdings Co., Ltd. He has a master's degree in Economics from the University of Sydney, as well as a bachelor's in Business Management, with a concentration in Financial Management. As CEO, Mr. Chen will oversee day-to-day operations and the continued execution of LQR's strategy.

As founder and Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Dollinger led LQR House from inception through its August 2023 initial public offering on NASDAQ and into a period of sustained capital formation and strategic expansion.

"I founded LQR House to build a spirits e-commerce and marketing company, and taking it to NASDAQ with the LQR team is something I will always be proud of," said Mr. Dollinger. "Together with the Board, we have charted a new direction for the company, centered on Fusion Five Continents Securities in New Zealand and AI compute for quantitative research under an agreement with ByteDance. That direction calls for a CEO whose experience is closely aligned with those areas. Stepping aside now is the right decision for me and for the company. I will continue to work on the spirits e-commerce and marketing company outside the public capital markets, while also turning my attention to new projects in Artificial Intelligence, and I will support Leo and the Board through the transition."

"On behalf of the Board, I want to thank Sean for founding LQR House and taking it public," said Mr. Lijun Chen (no relation to Leo Chen), Non Executive Chairman and Director of LQR House. "During his tenure, Sean led the company through significant capital raises and strategic transactions, and he made this current decision with LQR's next phase in mind. We look forward to his continued support during the transition."

Mr. Chen added, "Leo's strong finance background and years of executive experience will serve the company well as we develop Fusion Five Continents Securities into a truly AI-enabled brokerage platform, integrating financial research, portfolio analytics, and investment execution. The Board is confident in Leo's ability as CEO to drive LQR's next phase. I look forward to working closely with him and the senior leadership team to execute on our strategy."

LQR House has transitioned from the wine and spirits e-commerce sector to operating as a cross-border securities trading intermediary. Through its subsidiary Fusion Five Continents Securities, LQR House provides clients with access to U.S. and Hong Kong equity markets through an integrated operational framework that offers AI-driven research, quantitative analytics, and automated portfolio optimization. Distinguishing it from most financial intermediaries targeting Asian investors, Fusion Five is able to accept USDT deposits as a funding mechanism for securities trading, with settlement facilitated by a licensed trust company, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. Fusion Five has assembled an experienced technology team with credentials from Oxford, Stockholm University, and Tsinghua University, combining expertise in quantitative finance, AI, and behavioral data science. Fusion Five is deploying AI-driven capabilities across its operations to drive efficiency and enhance the client experience, while advancing its vision of an AI-enabled brokerage platform integrating financial research, portfolio analytics, and investment execution.
